items.title: Conditional Gaussian blocks: a prerequisite for Eq6

source.anchor: Section3.1 S3.SS1.p1.1-p3.2, Eq4-Eq6; AppendixB.2.3 Ex70 product-density context; regularity source Lemma3.4 and AppendixB.3 Ex73/Eq26/Ex74
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. ASTIS supplies the fixed-matrix conditional Gaussian product ingredient omitted between the literal Eq5 family and printed prior-averaged Eq6; it is not advertised as a separately printed author theorem.
source.scope: Fixed arbitrary tuple only. The common-sign independent prior average, actual density and amplification are separate obligations.

items.statement: For every fixed orthogonal tuple in the source block precision family, the actual centered Gaussian target becomes the independent product of its actual block Gaussians and the residual standard Gaussian under the literal contiguous coordinate split. This is the ASTIS-completed conditional ingredient of the printed prior-averaged Eq6. \mathrm{split}_{\#}\mathcal N(0,A_{\boldsymbol O}^{-1})=\left(\bigotimes_{j=1}^{k}\mathcal N(0,A_{O_j}^{-1})\right)\otimes\mathcal N(0,I_r). \(d,n\in\mathbb N,\ 3\le n\le d,\ \kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge4\), with inclusive endpoints. Put \(k=\lfloor d/n\rfloor\) and \(r=d-kn=d\bmod n\). \(\boldsymbol O=(O_1,\ldots,O_k)\in O(n)^k\) is any fixed tuple in the full real orthogonal group. The matrices may differ and their determinant signs may differ; no prior on the tuple is supplied. \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\) and \(A_{\boldsymbol O}=\operatorname{diag}(A_{O_1},\ldots,A_{O_k},I_r)\) are the existing literal source precision matrices. Positive definiteness, valid inverse covariances and independence are internal proof outputs. Coordinates are consecutive blocks: in zero-based indices, block entry \((j,i)\) is ambient coordinate \(jn+i\), and residual entry \(t\) is \(kn+t\). The split is a continuous linear coordinate bijection; no isometry for the ordinary max-normed product is asserted. When \(r=0\), the residual standard Gaussian is the unique probability measure on the zero-dimensional space. It is a point mass, not zero measure or a discarded unproved case. \mathrm{split}(x)=(x_1,\ldots,x_k,z),\quad (x_j)_i=x_{jn+i},\quad z_t=x_{kn+t}.
assumptions: \(d,n\in\mathbb N,\ 3\le n\le d,\ \kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge4\), with inclusive endpoints. Put \(k=\lfloor d/n\rfloor\) and \(r=d-kn=d\bmod n\).
\(\boldsymbol O=(O_1,\ldots,O_k)\in O(n)^k\) is any fixed tuple in the full real orthogonal group. The matrices may differ and their determinant signs may differ; no prior on the tuple is supplied.

\(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\) and \(A_{\boldsymbol O}=\operatorname{diag}(A_{O_1},\ldots,A_{O_k},I_r)\) are the existing literal source precision matrices. Positive definiteness, valid inverse covariances and independence are internal proof outputs.

Coordinates are consecutive blocks: in zero-based indices, block entry \((j,i)\) is ambient coordinate \(jn+i\), and residual entry \(t\) is \(kn+t\). The split is a continuous linear coordinate bijection; no isometry for the ordinary max-normed product is asserted.
When \(r=0\), the residual standard Gaussian is the unique probability measure on the zero-dimensional space. It is a point mass, not zero measure or a discarded unproved case.

obligations.label: The complete printed Eq6 law after actual independent common-sign prior averaging remains a separate target.

bindings.boundary: Only the actual fixed-tuple Gaussian factorization. No full Eq6 prior mixture, actual product density Ex70, affinity Ex71, amplified TV Ex72, oracle/precision/query cap/expected-cost adapter, hidden-eigenbasis or main lower bound is concluded. Local compilation is separate from independent source/semantic verification, root integration, publication, purification and whole-Goal completion.

assumption_deltas.source: Section3.1 fixes kappa>=4,3<=n<=d and defines Eq5 for every fixed tuple in O(n)^k.
assumption_deltas.lean: Exactly these domain inequalities and one arbitrary fixed tuple; actual precision/covariance constructors.
assumption_deltas.reason: All invertibility, positive covariance, map measurability and product-law properties are internally produced.

assumption_deltas.source: Eq6 prints the prior-averaged law; it omits a standalone fixed-tuple factorization proof.
assumption_deltas.lean: Prove only the fixed-tuple conditional producer; do not introduce a prior or advertise full Eq6.
assumption_deltas.reason: This is an explicitly attributed completion of an implicit ingredient. The binding is prerequisite, so the full averaged obligation stays open.

assumption_deltas.source: Coordinates are consecutive blocks and the residual has dimension d-kn; omit its factor when kn=d.
assumption_deltas.lean: The inlined equivalence is checked to give j*n+i and k*n+t. Use r=d%n and retain the unique zero-dimensional probability factor at r=0.
assumption_deltas.reason: Exact coordinate and probability-factor realization; no r>0 premise or zero-measure fallback.
